name: scraply
description: Local-first evidence-backed research and idea exploration desktop app.
author: Dany

scripts.clean:out: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['out/main', 'out/preload', 'out/renderer']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:release: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('release', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.package: bun run clean:release && bun run clean:out && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never && bun run verify:package
scripts.package:e2e: bun run clean:release && bun run clean:out && electron-vite build --mode e2e && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never
scripts.build:installed: bun run package && bun run install:local
scripts.test: bun test test/unit test/integration/backend.test.ts test/integration/recovery.test.ts test/integration/evidence-model.test.ts test/integration/idea-generation.test.ts test/integration/research-limits.test.ts test/integration/migrations.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.renderer.json && bun run test
